tip.title: Stay Aware
tip.description: Pay attention to your surroundings, especially in unfamiliar places.

tip.title: Share Your Plans
tip.description: Let someone you trust know your destination and expected arrival time.

tip.title: Keep Your Phone Ready
tip.description: Keep your phone charged and important emergency contacts accessible.

tip.title: Choose Safe Routes
tip.description: Use familiar, well-lit routes and trusted transport whenever possible.

tip.title: Trust Your Instincts
tip.description: If a situation feels unsafe, move toward a safer place and seek help.

tip.title: Emergency Contacts
tip.description: Save important emergency phone numbers on your phone.

tip.title: Protect Personal Information
tip.description: Avoid sharing your live location with unknown people.

tip.title: Stay Connected
tip.description: Keep a trusted person informed when travelling alone.

tip.title: Use Trusted Transport
tip.description: Choose reliable transport and check your route before leaving.

tip.title: Ask for Help
tip.description: Move to a safe public place and contact someone you trust if needed.
